# Definition 
**Placental Abruption** is detachment of the placenta from the uterus. 

# Risk Factors 
- HTN
- prior placental abruption
- cocaine & tobacco 
- twin gestation
- polyhydramnios (d/t tracheoesophageal fistula)

# Presentation 
- **sudden painful vaginal bleeding**
- $\pm$ high-frequency contractions 

# Diagnosis 
clinical:
- ultrasound $\pm$ retroplacental hematoma

# Complications 
- preterm birth, fetal death 
- postpartum hemorrhage
- DIC 

# Management 
- Urgent delivery
